gloss: to regard as, assume; to be about to, try to

definitions.gloss: to regard as; to assume; to take (something) as
definitions.explanation: After a noun or clause with と: to treat something as being so, to set a premise, or (passive とされる) to be considered or said to be. Common in written Japanese, news and rules.

definitions.gloss: to be about to; to try to (after the volitional form)
definitions.explanation: After the volitional form (〜う / 〜よう): to be on the point of doing something, or to try to do it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一|いち}{時間|じかん}→一時間：00941_ichijikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一単位|いちたんい}とする。
examples.english: One hour is taken as one unit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日本一|にほんいち}⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧とされる。
examples.english: Mt. Fuji is regarded as the most beautiful mountain in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仮|かり}→仮：11551_kari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧とする⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{延期|えんき}→延期：01888_enki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧だろう。
examples.english: Supposing it rains tomorrow, the match will probably be postponed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出|で}かけよう→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧とした{時|とき}、⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
examples.english: Just as I was about to go out, the phone rang.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{立|た}とう→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧として⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The child is trying to stand up on its own.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}そう→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧とした⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦どうしても→どうしても：03476_doushitemo⟧⟦{出|で}てこなかった→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧。
examples.english: I tried again and again to remember, but his name just would not come.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- X ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧Yとする: to take X as Y, to treat X as Y
- 〜とされる: is considered to be, is said to be (news and reference style)
- 〜とする⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ / 〜としたら / 〜とすれば: supposing that ~
- Verb volitional + とする: to try to, to be about to
- Verb volitional + としない: will not even try to (⟦{聞|き}こう→聞く：00483_kiku⟧としない, will not listen)

USAGE:
Sense 2 is about an attempt or a moment just before an action; it is not used for one's own deliberate experiments, which are 〜てみる.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜てみる: to try doing (to see what happens)
- として: as, in the capacity of
